title: manage_memory tool schema
description: Save, read, or delete user preferences and facts that persist across conversations. Call with action "write" when user states a preference ("I like watercolor style", "always use 16:9"). Call with action "read" to recall preferences before generating. Call with action "delete" to remove a preference. Do NOT save transient requests — only persistent preferences.

action.description: Action to perform. "read": list all saved memories. "write": save or update a preference. "delete": remove a preference by key.

key.description: Unique key for the memory (e.g. "preferred_style", "aspect_ratio", "quality_preference"). Required for write and delete.

value.description: Value to save. Required for write action. Be concise but specific.

category.description: Memory category. "preference": style/format preferences. "fact": user facts (name, location). "context": project context. Default: "preference".
